structure.aggregate: Service64 constrains initial controller, every management subprocess and fork, bootstrap leaf, target/admin16 and noop48. These are nested caps, never additive grants. Initial memory charges remain within the same service64 even when cgroup migration leaves earlier page charges at an ancestor.
structure.no_internal_process_sequence: Verify root64+actualDelegate; create bootstrap leaf and move own PID into it; independently read own /proc/cgroup and root cgroup.procs empty; only then enable +memory at delegated root. Create empty owned target64; enable its memory controller while it has no direct PIDs; create admin16/noop48; move own PID to admin and verify before any further child.
structure.cleanup: Only direct own fork PID migrates to noop48, verified through /proc/PID/cgroup before permit then irreversible UID/GID/groups drop. Reap within same deadline; cgroup.kill and rmdir only own empty noop. Empty bootstrap removed. Root writer remains in target/admin16 through final owned target restoration; target/admin retained for independent pop0 proof after process exits.
structure.empty_evidence: External witness must see entire systemd service root, owned target, retained admin, original shared and original project populated0, with no direct PIDs; subgroup empty never replaces whole-parent empty.
structure.service_lifecycle: Typeoneshot start job waits until admin exits; RemainAfterExit preserves active(exited) logical unit with no process. No --wait/--pipe because those wait for deactivation. Final witness requires MainPID0/ControlPID0/noJob/ExecMainStatus0/active(exited), actual same root+target dev/ino, and all empty. No daemon or holder process survives.

authority.kernel_write_boundary: Only descendants created below verified delegated service, plus documented delegated root cgroup.subtree_control/cgroup.procs interfaces. Never create manual cgroups directly below a managed slice; never change managed-root memory/swap/oom attributes.
authority.outer_bootstrap: Only immutable controller verification/copy, standard fixed512/64 slice configuration and delegated service launch/start-job wait; no raw DATA, Subject, token or network other than fetching this administrative controller.
authority.outside_witness: Read-only original slices, actual service properties and owned metadata/terminal; no stop/kill/restore.

official_contracts.contract: Delegate applies only to service/scope; manager owns unit attributes, delegate owns descendants. Do not hand-create under managed slices. Move process into a leaf before enabling domain controllers.
cgroup.procs moves own forked processes; descendants remain constrained by ancestor limits. No internal PIDs when distributing domain controllers; empty leaf directories may be removed.
RemainAfterExit keeps service logically active after all processes exit. Typeoneshot startup waits for command completion; bounded TimeoutStartSec is used here.
Normal invocation waits for start-job completion; --wait/--pipe wait for service termination and are deliberately not used with retained active(exited) service.
